details:
I am writing this report to share my thoughts on the new “like” and “dislike” system.

I believe the “like” and “dislike” system is unnecessary.

As for “like,” we already have the “Favorites” feature, which essentially functions as a “like” button.

As for “dislike,” malicious users could potentially use it to review bombing , which could lead to emotional distress for creators, a decline in motivation, and even the deletion or privacy-setting of their work.

I believe this would be disastrous for VRChat, which has a large community of creators.

Therefore, I would like to make a proposal.

Instead of a “Dislike” button, 

I think it would be good to add two features.

First, I think a “Not Interested” button, similar to YouTube’s, would be ideal. The reason is that it would bepurely client-side,only affects that specific user  .

Second, I suggest adding a “Do Not Recommend to Other Users” button to the report menu. Users would submit a report along with a brief reason.

I think the reasons should be specific to issues like “misleading thumbnails” or “spam uploads.”

I hope you’ll consider this as one point of view.
title: My Thoughts on the Like/Dislike System
